The S2 PR-injection image: the suite-base image with PR #9343
(omacom/omarchy) applied at BUILD time via the omarchy-pr-9343 candy,
plus the declarative behavior check. The PR changes bin/omarchy-migrate
to fail --pending with exit 2 + "migrations directory missing" when the
migrations dir is absent (upstream main exits 1 silently). The check
passes ONLY with the PR applied — the injection proof. The check is
idempotent: the missing-dir path exits before any mutation.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `omarchy-pr-9343`
